name: CSOAI Universal Evaluator
description: Thin orchestrator MCP: composes the estate's evidence engines (ProvBench, C2PA manifest, corpus anchor/drift, governance crosswalk) into one structured, understandable evaluation. No new measurements — every field names its source engine; unmeasured stays null. Audit-trail sigil appended per call.
honesty: field is null 'unmeasured' when its engine did not run or its artifact is missing; orchestrator adds no judgement
